messages:
Ravi (AE): Heads-up from MistralBank POC — they want a small compliance bundle: SOC 2 excerpt, ISO/IEC snippet focused on data residency, a signed pen-test attestation, and answers to a short security questionnaire. Also flag: they asked whether a short dedicated-node POC would change pricing. Can we scope this?
Tess (Solutions Eng): I can assemble SOC2 + ISO snippets and draft answers to their questionnaire (about data handling, backups, and key management). If they want a dedicated node POC, we need to quote reserved capacity pricing — that will be separate from the evidence handoff.
Ibrahim (Security): Questionnaire items: we should confirm acceptable testing types, redaction policy, and what artifacts we can share (no KMS material, no raw audit logs). For the pen-test attestation we need signer_name, title, company_reg_no, and explicit scope. Also confirm whether they require DPO/Privacy sign-off.
Ravi (AE): Mistral contact: security@mistralbank.eu. They asked for DPO signature in addition to security contact. DPO is L. Santos. They requested an unauthenticated scan window next Thu 15:00 CET for 45 mins on staging.
Clara (Infra): For an unauth scan we need source IPs and UA, plus expected request rate. We'll provision a temporary allowlist and monitoring.
Tess (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a presigned evidence package with SOC2 excerpt, ISO residency excerpt, and filled questionnaire draft. Will deliberately exclude any KMS details.
Ravi (AE): Mistral provided IPs: 18.184.22.77 and UA: "MistralAudit/1.0". Rate: low, ~20r/s. Hostnames: staging-eu.mistralbank.eu
Ibrahim (Security): Low rate OK. We'll redact any internal ticket IDs and production hostnames. Note: if they require DPO signature, Legal will request company registration number and the DPO's contact for verification.
Ravi (AE): Filling LegalBot fields now: signer_name: Laura Santos; signer_title: Data Protection Officer; company_name: Mistral Bank PLC; company_reg_no: IE-55443322; testing_scope: unauthenticated external vuln scan of staging-eu.mistralbank.eu only; desired_return_email: security@mistralbank.eu
LegalBot: Received fields. Also ask whether Mistral requires additional regulatory language (e.g., GDPR-specific clauses). Reply with yes/no and attach requested language. Once verified we'll return signed attestation PDF within 48 hours.
Ravi (AE): Mistral says yes, they want a GDPR clause referencing data processing boundaries.
Tess (Solutions Eng): Uploaded evidence bundle (24h presign): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/mistral/evidence-bundle.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400 
Clara (Infra): Firewall change plan: open 18.184.22.77/32 at Thu 14:55 CET, close at 15:50 CET. Adding alerts and auto-rollback on anomalous traffic >150 r/s. Example CIDR to apply:
```
18.184.22.77/32
```
Clara (Infra): Also want the scanner UA string so we can fingerprint.
Ravi (AE): UA is "MistralAudit/1.0". Passing to Mistral DPO for confirmation.
Ibrahim (Security): I'll review the uploaded bundle and confirm redactions. LegalBot, please include GDPR clause in the attestation template.
LegalBot: Noted. We'll include standard GDPR processing language and return signed attestation within 48 hours after redaction confirmation.
Ravi (AE): Thanks team  I'll update thread when DPO confirms. :handshake:
